messages:
Clara: Heads-up — OrionMed onboarding request. They want traffic pinned to us-west-2 for a HIPAA pilot, proxy peering, and an allowlist. Mentioned a short demo spike and want a renewal discussion in ~5 weeks; cost sensitivity noted.
devin_net: OK, please capture CIDRs/ASN and ops contact. We need LOA for the peering and to schedule ACL changes. Which demo window?
Clara: Demo window they requested: 2026-08-02T15:00Z -> 2026-08-06T15:00Z. Ops contact infra@orionmed.io. CIDRs: 198.51.100.0/26, 203.0.113.32/27, NAT 198.18.1.11. They've asked for proxy peering (not VPC).
Samira_se: Great. Current rate tier for them is 50 req/min per route. For demo recommend a temporary bump to 400/min and a dedicated route so KV/prefix cache affinity holds. Suggest pre-warm 24h before the exec window.
Owen_csm: I'll schedule the renewal touchpoint and prepare a concise cost/throughput deck. Add a flag to "needs_enablement" and include ROI slide. Also will run a short post-demo feedback survey focusing on latency and error rates.
Luis_ops: Ephemeral allowlist OK. Propose TTL=11 days and auto-revoke on 2026-08-17T15:00Z UTC. We'll send CS notify 48h before revoke. Approve the TTL if infra is OK.
devin_net: Approved. I can queue peering/ACL task once LOA and signed window are in the ticket. I'll create a pinned route and ACLs; change_id=chg_om_20260802_01.
Samira_se: Pasting single-source-of-truth route config for infra ops:
```
route: /v1/generate/orionmed
region_pin: us-west-2
route_mode: dedicated
rate_limit: 400/min
kv_cache: { warmup: true }
allowlist_cidrs:
  - 198.51.100.0/26
  - 203.0.113.32/27
  - 198.18.1.11/32
ephemeral_ttl_days: 11
auto_revoke_at: 2026-08-17T15:00Z
enablement_flag: "needs_enablement"
notes: "HIPAA pilot demo 2026-08-02 -> 2026-08-06; pre-warm 24h; CS to run post-demo survey & renewal cost walkthrough"
```
change-bot: network-change: scheduled change for customer=orionmed, change_id=chg_om_20260802_01, status=scheduled, exec_window=2026-08-02T03:00Z->2026-08-02T05:00Z UTC
Luis_ops: I'll set auto-notify 48h before TTL expiry and own auto-revoke. Owen, please add the renewal touchpoint to the customer timeline and send the enablement invite.
Owen_csm: Will do. Tagging @Clara for LOA follow-up. Thanks team :white_check_mark:
